_comment: Machine-readable twin of the size/complexity thresholds declared in AGENTS.md
(section 'Code structure'). AGENTS.md stays the human-readable source; this file
is what tooling reads so a rule is never enforced at a value it does not declare.
scripts/validate_conventions.py fails CI when the two drift apart.

file_size._agents_md: flag >500 LOC new file; propose extraction >800 LOC existing; mandatory refactor >1500 LOC
